senses.gloss: m. (הזם, cmp. חזם) a prickly shrub, prob. Spina Regia (v. Löw Aram. Pfl. p. 231 a. quot. ib. from Plin. Hist. Nat.).
units: Tosef. Kil. I, 11 you must not plant cuscuta על גבי האי׳ ed. Zuck. (Var. אזמאזמא, corr. acc.) on izma.—Pl. הִיזְמֵי.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 31:40">Targ. Job XXXI, 40</cite> <he>הז׳</he> (Ms. <he>הוּ׳</he>).—
Keth. 77ᵇ שכר של הי׳ beer containing (in place of hops) cuscuta growing on hizmé.—Mostly in connection with היגי, v. הֵיגְתָא.
